description: Design-token foundation: rewrite mobile/lib/app/theme.dart so it is the single source for every color/text style/radius from design-mapping.md §1 and §4; copy the onboarding hero asset and wire it into pubspec; and create the shared presentational widget library under mobile/lib/core/widgets/ (design-mapping.md §3). This is the hard dependency for every screen feature; after it, the app still builds and existing screens render with the refreshed theme.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/design-mapping.md FULLY, especially §1 (tokens), §3 (widget inventory + icon map) and §4 (theme build spec). Read mobile/lib/app/theme.dart to preserve its public surface.

Rewrite mobile/lib/app/theme.dart: keep existing static const Color names and AppTheme.light(); ADD the new consts from §1.1 (primaryFixed #bdece0, primaryFixedDim #a2d0c4, onPrimaryFixed #00201b, onPrimaryFixedVariant #224e46, onSecondaryContainer #663500, secondaryFixedDim #ffb77d, onSecondaryFixed #2f1500, onSecondaryFixedVariant #6e3900, onTertiaryContainer #34b488, tertiaryFixed #80f9c8, tertiaryFixedDim #62dcad, surfaceBright #effcf9, surfaceDim #cfddd9, surfaceCardBorder #d0e7e1, surfaceTint #3b665d). Add radius2xl=16 and radius3xl=24.

Populate the ColorScheme in AppTheme.light() from every token in §1.1 (primary/secondary/tertiary families, all surface-container levels, outline, inverse*, error family). Map scheme.surfaceContainerHighest and the deprecated surfaceVariant both to #d8e5e2.

Build the TextTheme from GoogleFonts.plusJakartaSansTextTheme().copyWith(...) per the §1.2 table: Newsreader for displayLarge(36/600/-0.02em tracking)/displayMedium(32/600)/displaySmall(28/600/-0.01em)/headlineMedium(24/500/-0.01em); Plus Jakarta Sans for headlineSmall(18/600), titleLarge(20/700), titleMedium(16/600), bodyLarge(16/400 h1.63), bodyMedium(14/400 h1.57), labelMedium(12/600 0.04em), labelSmall(11/500 0.02em). Set height=lineHeight/size and letterSpacing=em*size (logical px).

Add static text-style helpers on AppTheme (or a sibling AppTextStyles): transliteration (Newsreader italic 15/h1.6/onSurfaceVariant), arabicAyahLg (fontFamily 'UthmanicHafs' 30/h2.27/w500/primary), arabicAyahSm ('UthmanicHafs' 24/h2.25/w500/primary). Do NOT add the UthmanicHafs font to pubspec.

Update component themes per §4: scaffoldBackgroundColor surface; cardTheme surfaceContainerLowest + radiusXl (card border is onboarding-local, not global); filledButtonTheme primaryContainer/onPrimary minHeight52 radiusLg; outlinedButtonTheme primary fg + outlineVariant side; navigationBarTheme surface, selected primary+semibold vs onSurfaceVariant; progressIndicatorTheme secondaryContainer on surfaceContainerHigh track.
Copy design/stitch/screenshots/onboarding-hero.jpg to mobile/assets/images/onboarding-hero.jpg (create the directory). Use a shell copy (cp).

Edit mobile/pubspec.yaml: under flutter: add an assets: block listing assets/images/onboarding-hero.jpg (or assets/images/). Leave the commented UthmanicHafs font block untouched. Run flutter pub get.

Create mobile/lib/core/widgets/ shared presentational widgets from §3 that are cross-feature: hudaayah_top_bar.dart (HudaayahTopBar with tab label + optional streak chip + bell), chips.dart (StreakChip, CountChip), filter_chip_bar.dart (FilterChipBar), search_field.dart (SearchField), buttons.dart (PrimaryPillButton, AuthProviderButton, SecondaryButton), option_card.dart (OptionCard with letter badge + states), segmented_progress_bar.dart (SegmentedProgressBar), progress_ring.dart (ProgressRing via CustomPaint), feedback_drawer.dart (FeedbackDrawer), stat_card.dart (StatCard, MetricCell), info_card.dart (InfoCard). All stateless/presentational, theme from context, icons per §3.1. Feature-specific widgets (SurahListTile, AudioStrip, HabitCard, SettingsTile, HistoryTile, ResumeBanner, StreakSummaryCard, ReaderFloatingControls, LessonJourneyTile) are built in their own features in later FEATs, not here.
Run the verification gate and record results in findings.
acceptance_criteria: mobile/lib/app/theme.dart compiles and exposes all §1.1 color consts, the §1.2 TextTheme, the arabic/transliteration static styles, and radius2xl/radius3xl.
mobile/assets/images/onboarding-hero.jpg exists and is referenced in pubspec.yaml under flutter: assets:.
mobile/lib/core/widgets/ contains the cross-feature widgets listed in step 9, each presentational.
UthmanicHafs font block in pubspec.yaml remains commented (font not added).
flutter pub get succeeds and flutter analyze reports zero new errors.
verification: cd mobile && flutter build apk --debug  (fallback if toolchain unavailable: flutter build web OR dart analyze only — record which ran)
findings:
THEME (lib/app/theme.dart): AppTheme now the single token source. All §1.1 color consts present incl. new ones (primaryFixed/primaryFixedDim/onPrimaryFixed/onPrimaryFixedVariant, onSecondaryContainer/secondaryFixedDim/onSecondaryFixed/onSecondaryFixedVariant, onTertiaryContainer/tertiaryFixed/tertiaryFixedDim, surfaceBright/surfaceContainerHighest/surfaceDim/surfaceCardBorder/surfaceTint, inverseSurface/onInverseSurface, errorContainer/onError/onErrorContainer). surfaceVariant const kept (#d8e5e2) and scheme.surfaceContainerHighest mapped to same. Radii: radiusLg=8, radiusXl=12, radius2xl=16, radius3xl=24. headlineMedium is weight w500 (per §1.2, not w600). Text styles with no M3 slot live on a sibling class AppTextStyles (NOT on AppTheme): AppTextStyles.transliteration (Newsreader italic 15/h1.6), AppTextStyles.arabicAyahLg (UthmanicHafs 30/h2.27/w500/primary), AppTextStyles.arabicAyahSm (UthmanicHafs 24/h2.25/w500/primary). Import both: `import '../../app/theme.dart';` exposes AppTheme and AppTextStyles. Component themes set: scaffoldBackgroundColor=surface, appBarTheme (surface bg, transparent tint, 0 elevation), cardTheme (surfaceContainerLowest + radiusXl, NO global border — card border is onboarding-local), filledButtonTheme (primaryContainer/onPrimary, minHeight52, radiusLg), outlinedButtonTheme (primary fg + outlineVariant side, radiusLg), navigationBarTheme (surface, transparent indicator, selected primary+w600 vs onSurfaceVariant), progressIndicatorTheme (secondaryContainer on surfaceContainerHigh track).

ASSET: mobile/assets/images/onboarding-hero.jpg copied; pubspec flutter: assets: lists 'assets/images/onboarding-hero.jpg'. UthmanicHafs font block REMAINS COMMENTED (font not added). pubspec.lock unchanged (already committed).

SHARED WIDGETS (lib/core/widgets/, all stateless/presentational, theme-from-context):
- hudaayah_top_bar.dart -> HudaayahTopBar({required String tab, int? streakDays, VoidCallback? onBellTap}); height 64, surface@0.9.
- chips.dart -> StreakChip({required int days}); CountChip({required String label}).
- filter_chip_bar.dart -> FilterChipBar({required List<String> labels, required int selectedIndex, required ValueChanged<int> onSelected}) (selection state owned by caller).
- search_field.dart -> SearchField({String hintText, TextEditingController? controller, ValueChanged<String>? onChanged}).
- buttons.dart -> PrimaryPillButton({required String label, required VoidCallback? onPressed, IconData? trailingIcon=arrow_forward}); AuthProviderButton({required Widget leading, required String label, required VoidCallback? onPressed}) (null onPressed => disabled/opacity 0.5); SecondaryButton({required String label, required VoidCallback? onPressed, IconData? leadingIcon}).
- option_card.dart -> OptionCard({required String letter, required String label, required bool selected, required VoidCallback? onTap}) (selected = primaryFixed fill + primaryContainer badge + tertiaryFixedDim check).
- segmented_progress_bar.dart -> SegmentedProgressBar({required int total, required int current}).
- progress_ring.dart -> ProgressRing({required double percent (0..1), double size=64, double strokeWidth=6, String? label}) via CustomPaint.
- feedback_drawer.dart -> FeedbackDrawer({required bool correct, required String message, String? reflection, String? xpLabel, required VoidCallback onContinue, String continueLabel='Continue'}). xpLabel omitted when server returns none (never fabricated).
- stat_card.dart -> StatCard({required IconData icon, required String value, required String caption, Color? iconColor}); MetricCell({required IconData icon, required String value, required String caption, Color? iconColor}).
- info_card.dart -> InfoCard({required IconData icon, required String title, required String body, Color? backgroundColor, Color? iconTileColor, Color? iconColor}).
Feature-local widgets (HabitCard, LessonJourneyTile, SurahListTile, ResumeBanner, AudioStrip, ReaderFloatingControls, StreakSummaryCard, HistoryTile, SettingsTile) were NOT built here — they belong to later per-feature FEATs.

VERIFICATION / BUILD GATE THAT ACTUALLY RAN: `flutter pub get` OK. `flutter analyze` => 'No issues found!' (clean, 0 errors/warnings/infos after fixing one doc-comment html-in-comment lint). `flutter test` and `flutter build apk --debug` are BLOCKED in this environment by a Dart native-assets hook failure building package:objective_c ('Building native assets for package:objective_c failed', kernel generation exit 254) — transitive via just_audio, NOT related to FEAT-001 code. `flutter build web` is unavailable ('project is not configured for the web'). GATE USED = flutter analyze (clean) + flutter pub get. Later FEATs: the apk/test gate will keep failing on this native-assets hook until the host toolchain is fixed; rely on `flutter analyze` as the standing compile gate, or resolve the objective_c native-assets build in the environment.
